observations.description: Component identities must exactly match policy required_components and OWNER_CONTEXT_COMPONENTS. Swap, duplicate, omit, blend, and extra all reject.
Task name, path, executable, script, single-instance policy, restart policy count, restart interval, and instance count must all match exactly.
Task state alone is insufficient — task_running requires installed + state in permitted + last_result in permitted. Disabled, Unknown, and wrong states produce TASK_NOT_RUNNING.
Sandbox-context visibility is rejected with 'owner-context visibility' error — never interpreted as NOT_INSTALLED or healthy.
Stale collection (collected_at older than RPO) rejects at adapter level. Future collection rejects.
Heartbeat cannot follow collection — future or post-collection heartbeat rejects in SanitizedComponentFactsV1.__post_init__.
trading_authority is hardcoded False in every ComponentObservationV1 produced. AdaptedOwnerContextHealthV1.trading_authority defaults to False.
Windows path validation: PureWindowsPath, casefold, is_absolute, no '..' traversal. Forward slashes normalized.
No os/subprocess/socket/requests/ctypes/win32com imports. No task control functions. Read-only by design.
Dependency-injected reader exceptions are wrapped as OwnerContextAdapterError. Wrong type, None, and cross-component returns all reject.

accepted: All records are frozen and deterministic
